method: All three exported PNG files visually inspected with view_image; numerical and rendered audits recorded separately.

panels.a: All six methods and all three full-window means visible; old/refreshed teacher policy identified consistently.
panels.b: Three per-seed dots and ensemble difference visible; ensemble RMSE differences positive in all windows.
panels.c: Four monitoring points retained; final MJ3 errors and relative B+ results visible.
panels.d: Full 0-105% range retained; cached ATU5 and refreshed ATU1 undercoverage visible.

panels.a: ATU1 observed tail rise and model discrepancy visible; actual bands and seeds retained.
panels.b: ATU5 narrow interval and uncovered observations visible.
panels.c: MJ3 flat trajectory and broad uncertainty visible across the whole prediction period.
panels.d: MJ1 full trajectory and finite interval visible.

panels.a: ATU1 tail underprediction and undercoverage visible.
panels.b: ATU5 improved RMSE and wider uncertainty visible.
panels.c: MJ3 flat/down-biased prediction retained with no tail removal.
panels.d: MJ1 discrepancy and full interval retained.

layout: Titles, legends, dates, units and below-panel annotations readable; no clipped data or observed overlap. Four-point figures use identical pointwise axes.
limits: Visual inspection establishes legibility, not model effectiveness or mentor acceptance.
